title: Phase 1 repository-intelligence benchmark

conditions.description: Agent receives the pinned repository checkout and ordinary shell/file tools only. No Agent-Ready snapshot or twin query.

Same environment, model, agent configuration, task prompt, and repository SHA as raw, plus Discovery Snapshot Format 1 produced by agent-ready discover (or twin build) and bounded twin query over that snapshot.

immutability: Once protocol v1 is used for evaluation, this directory is frozen. Changes require protocolVersion 2 in a sibling directory; v1 artifacts and results remain.
